title: UI风格#106 - Art Deco Cinema (装饰艺术影院)
description: 创建第106种UI风格：装饰艺术影院风格 - 电影幕布、流金岁月、经典好莱坞。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDB.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Cinema style When color palette Then features velvet red, gold leaf, silver screen, black velvet
Given Art Deco Cinema style When typography Then uses glamour fonts: Cinzel, Playfair Display, or Poiret One
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Cinzel (标题), Playfair Display (正文), Poiret One (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Cinema style When layout Then cinema curtain, film reel, marquee lights, art deco patterns
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：影院幕布、胶片盘、霓虹灯箱、装饰艺术图案

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Cinema style When UI elements Then curtain reveal, marquee animation, film grain, spotlight
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：幕布拉开、灯箱闪烁、胶片颗粒、聚光灯

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Cinema UI When functional Then includes cinema chat, director agents, reel stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：影院聊天、导演代理、胶片统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Art Deco Cinema UI When copy Then uses hollywood: 'Scene', 'Cut', 'Reel', 'Frame'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SCENE. CUT. REEL.'、按钮'SEND'→'ACTION'、'SUBMIT'→'CUT'
